name: CA-02
label: Safe D

key_factors: District's strong Democratic lean (D+13 partisan baseline)
Incumbent Jared Huffman running with a large cash advantage
Republican challenger Robin Littau has reported no fundraising
Prediction markets price Huffman at roughly 97% to win
model.rationale: Huffman holds a heavily Democratic North Coast seat, has over $1 million on hand, and faces a challenger with no visible fundraising or outside support. Markets and fundamentals both point to an easy incumbent win, so the forecast stays near the fundamentals-based margin.
model.watch: A surprise surge in challenger fundraising or outside spending, or an unexpected shift in the national environment, would be the main things to monitor, though neither appears likely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
California's 2nd District is a strongly Democratic seat on the North Coast, and incumbent Jared Huffman is seeking another term. He has raised nearly $1 million and holds more than $1 million in cash, while Republican challenger Robin Littau has reported no fundraising activity and draws no outside spending on either side. No public general-election polls are available for the race, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Huffman roughly a 97% chance of winning, consistent with the district's Democratic lean and the incumbent's financial dominance. The forecast expects Huffman to win by a wide, roughly twenty-point margin, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling.
